text:
toni: quick brain-dump: propose 'surgical peel' pattern for long-term modularization — systematically extract one small hotpath from the session-sidecar each sprint. want quick thumbs before i write the RFC.

yusuf: what counts as a "small hotpath"?

toni: think: code that holds global locks, is tenant-specific, and causes GC or tail spikes. examples: per-tenant rate-limiter, prefix-cache, request-coalescer. goal: reduce global sharing surface incrementally.

clare: migration model? big-bang or incremental?

toni: always incremental. pattern: (1) isolate logic behind an interface; (2) implement adapter that can run in shadow; (3) sticky-route a cohort; (4) cutover reads/writes; (5) prune. Each step has clear metrics & rollback.

ben: metrics & guardrails?

toni: gate on p95 latency, error_rate, cache_hit_ratio (if applicable), and a small quality eval set. rollback if p95 > +10% absolute or errors +1% absolute. Also add memory_pressure for any adapter.

infra-bot: /epic create surgical-peel-epic -> id sp-175999

yusuf: ops complexity: lots of adapters = more knobs. how to keep ops low?

toni: standardize adapters into one binary with flags. same metrics, same autoscaling hooks. default budgets conservative; only high-traffic tenants get special config. docs + runbooks generated by a template.

clare: consistency concerns across joins or cross-tenant ops?

toni: keep cross-tenant logic in session-core. adapters only handle tenant-local hotpaths. For cases needing consistency we do read-verify or route to core. Example: the coalescer used by join paths stays in core for now.

ben: testing & stage plan?

toni: staging replay + spike test. shadow run for 48h, then 0.5% canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%. hold 24h at 25% for risky cohorts. also chaos test adapter failure modes.

yusuf: can you sketch a template for an RFC that we can reuse?

toni: sure, RFC sections: motivation, interface contract, migration plan (phases), gating & metrics, cost estimate, tests & canary plan, runbook, rollbacks, open questions. I'll include a sample checklist.

clare: cost impact? extra CPU/instances during cutover?

toni: short-term bump during canary and shadow replays. steady-state likely neutral or lower because we reduce retries and contention. will include token-cost projection in RFC.

ben: quick snippet for shadow run command?

toni: paste: ```
# run adapter in shadow mode for tenant X
./bin/adapter --tenant $TENANT --mode=shadow --log-level=info
```

clare: who owns initial RFC and timeline?

toni: i'll draft a thin RFC by Fri. yusuf + clare to review. ben to own staging harness. i'll create the epic ticket and add the first peel target (rate-limiter).

infra-bot: epic sp-175999 created; cohort peel-rate-limiter scheduled

yusuf: +1. please include sample dashboards and the runbook template.

clare: +1 and add a short section on how we'll track tech-debt reduction (scorecard).

toni: good call. i'll add a simple debt-score metric: #shared-hotpaths reduced, p95 tail improvement, and number of knobs removed. will attach to epic.

ben: action items:
- toni: RFC draft by Fri + sample dashboard
- ben: staging harness baseline by Wed
- clare: debt-score proposal by Thu
- yusuf: runbook template and alert thresholds by Thu

toni: thanks all — small, repeatable slices. i'll post RFC link here when ready. :seedling:
